policy_event.rule: 2025-10-02 interim final rule: statewide OEWS-based field-and-livestock AEWRs by skill level

period.transition_note: FY2026 begins one day before the rule; cases decided early in FY2026 under prior rates attenuate the intent-to-treat slope

treatment.units_note: PPI for 2026 is unavailable; identifying gaps are within fiscal year, so real units are a common rescaling
treatment.estimation_only_sensitivity: max(AEWR, applicable state agricultural minimum wage); not used in power

outcome.post_period_requirement: Upstream a01/b01 producers must parse FY2025 and FY2026 disclosure files before estimation; this registry never reads post outcomes.

geography.assignment: each county joins the state-border pair with the most qualifying cross-border neighbors; ties by lexical pair id; drop pairs without both sides and repeat until stable

calibration.primary_reason: FY2020 onward allocates certifications with Addendum B worksite records, the measurement regime of the post period; the owning county-year producer (h2a_data_year) currently ends at FY2022
calibration.data_note: FY2023-FY2024 worksite allocations exist upstream but are not aggregated by the owning producer; they are not re-aggregated here

power_settings_source: design.json redesign.power and redesign.precision_assumptions (unchanged DGPs, fractions, seed, repetitions, effect and MDE grids, size gate)
node_interpretation: power helpers' aewr_region_id field carries state_fips; region shocks are state shocks

outcome_variants.sample: all memberships with positive fixed 2011 farm employment

outcome_variants.added: 2026-10-18, before any post-policy outcome is parsed
outcome_variants.sample: counties with positive hourly-offer certified hours in every calibration year; pairs must keep both sides
outcome_variants.sample_note: pre-period participation restriction; post-period estimation also requires post-period offers

precision.note: Declared pass-through of offered wages per statutory dollar; not user-supplied

outcome_variants.not_used: mean_hourly_wage_fiscal_year is worker-weighted, ignores the pay unit and is fiscal-year based; owned by b01 and not used here
outcome_variants.upstream_revision: 2026-10-18, before any post-policy outcome is parsed: b01 caps hourly offers at $100 (employer-error screen), affecting calibration inputs only

selection_rule: No outcome-based selection. The primary geography, treatment, calibration and scenario are fixed here; every sensitivity and failed gate is reported.
